policy.asset_independence: Every active project is a standalone intellectual-property asset with its own TA-IP identifier, commercial reference or explicit pending-reference status, rights perimeter, diligence scope and transaction pathway.
policy.family_role: Families are classification and navigation categories only. A family is not itself an IP asset, does not merge member assets, and does not imply common ownership boundaries, technical interchangeability or automatic bundling.
policy.multi_asset_transactions: Two or more standalone assets may be negotiated together only when the transaction documents explicitly identify each included asset and its rights perimeter.
policy.repository_intake: Repository existence alone does not automatically place a project in the active commercial register. New repositories are added only after separate asset qualification and commercial metadata are established.

retired.note: Withdrawn from the active commercial portfolio after repository retirement; identifier retained for historical continuity and is not reused.
